article.headline: Meragi vs The Wedding Company: Two Different Bets on India's Wedding Fulfilment Market
article.description: Meragi has raised $14.8M and bets on premium 3D design. The Wedding Company raised $3.75M, hit profitability, and bets on contractual accountability at 4% planning fees. Two different strategies. Different customers. Different product advantages. Neither has won yet.
